q1: SELECT b1.name AS bar1, b2.name AS bar2 FROM bar AS b1, bar AS b2 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT s1.beer FROM serves AS s1 WHERE s1.bar = b1.name AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serves AS s2 WHERE s2.bar = b2.name AND s2.beer = s1.beer)) AND EXISTS(SELECT s2.beer FROM serves AS s2 WHERE s2.bar = b2.name AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serves AS s1 WHERE s1.bar = b1.name AND s1.beer = s2.beer))
q2: SELECT b1.name AS bar1, b2.name AS bar2 FROM bar AS b1, bar AS b2 WHERE b1.name <> b2.name AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT beer FROM serves AS s2 WHERE s2.bar = b2.name AND NOT s2.beer IN (SELECT beer FROM serves AS s1 WHERE s1.bar = b1.name))

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because they check for different conditions regarding the beers served by two bars. Q1 checks for beers that are served by one bar but not by another, while Q2 checks for beers that are served by one bar but not by the other in general, not necessarily by the same beer.
